record.paper_title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
record.original_question: Can one prove superlinear lower bounds for Boolean circuits whose depth is logarithmic in the number of inputs, that is, O(log n)?

evidence.quote: Can we at least prove superlinear lower bounds on circuits of logarithmic (i.e., O(log n)) depth?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider Boolean circuits over the standard basis (AND, OR, NOT) with bounded fan-in (say fan-in 2), computing Boolean functions $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$. The size of a circuit is the number of gates, and its depth is the length of the longest path from an input to the output gate.

Exhibit an explicit family of Boolean functions $\{f_n\}_{n\ge 1}$, with $f_n:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ computable by some uniform algorithm (e.g., in NP, or even just in some explicit complexity class), together with a function $s(n) = \omega(n)$, such that any Boolean circuit of depth $O(\log n)$ computing $f_n$ must have size at least $s(n)$.

Equivalently: prove that there exists an explicit Boolean function family that cannot be computed by Boolean circuits of simultaneously linear size $O(n)$ and logarithmic depth $O(\log n)$, with a superlinear size lower bound holding for all $O(\log n)$-depth circuits computing it.
artifact.status_search_result: Proving a superlinear size lower bound for any explicit Boolean function on circuits of depth O(log n) (over the standard unbounded basis) is a well-known and long-standing open problem in circuit complexity. No such lower bound is currently known; even for restricted models such as linear/XOR circuits of logarithmic depth, no superlinear bounds are known. Recent surveys and works (e.g., Golovnev–Kulikov on circuit depth reductions, and standard complexity references) confirm the problem remains open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing superlinear lower bounds for log-depth circuits as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The question is explicitly listed as an open problem in circuit complexity surveys.

status_evidence.title: Circuit Depth Reductions (Golovnev, Kulikov)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses approaches and reductions but no superlinear lower bound for log-depth circuits is established.
status_evidence.claim: Recent ECCC report confirms no superlinear lower bound for log-depth Boolean circuits is known.

status_evidence.title: Complexity Lower Bounds using Linear Algebra (Lokam)
status_evidence.snippet: Notes that even for linear circuits of logarithmic depth, no superlinear lower bounds are known.
status_evidence.claim: Even restricted versions of the problem remain open.
